# Jubilees Chapter 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Jacob Refuses Canaanite Wives; Rebecca's Instructions; Jacob's Blessing

---

**25:1** And in the second year of this week, Rebecca called Jacob her son and spoke to him, saying: "My son, do not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan, as Esau your brother has done, who has taken two wives from the daughters of Canaan. And they have embittered my spirit because of all their works which are unclean, for all their ways are fornication and lust and there is no righteousness with them, for their ways are evil.

**25:2** And I, my son, love you exceedingly and my heart and my affection rejoice over you, that I should keep you that you do not marry one of the daughters of Canaan.

**25:3** Go to the house of your grandfather Bethuel, and take from there a wife for yourself from the daughters of your mother's brother Laban. Take a wife from there who is good and straight.

**25:4** And I know that she will be good for you, and you will be a blessing upon the earth and for all your descendants upon the earth.

**25:5** And I will not count all the days which I shall live as days of rejoicing unless I see your children, and unless I know that you will go from my presence and take for yourself a wife from that place.

**25:6** And go, my son, and your mother's brother Laban will embrace you and rejoice over you, and take a wife from his daughters. I know that the LORD will bless you above all my sons, because you are the firstborn and the holy one.

**25:7** I will go and pray and petition the LORD your God that he may guide you in the right way, and that you may find a good wife and that the LORD may bless all your descendants with righteousness throughout all the generations of the earth."

**25:8** And Jacob said to his mother Rebecca: "I will not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan, and I will not take an evil wife, because all your commandments and the commandments of Abraham my father are exceedingly pleasing to me, and my father Isaac has also commanded me not to take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.

**25:9** Do not be troubled on my account, mother, for I will walk in righteousness."

**25:10** And Rebecca arose and embraced Jacob her son and kissed him and loved him exceedingly, more than all his children.

**25:11** And she said to him: "Be blessed, my son, by the LORD of all, even the God who has created the heavens and the earth, and I pray that he may bless you above all generations of mankind. And may he give to you, my son, righteousness and holiness and may he sanctify you. And may he plant you in the earth and establish you and raise you up.

**25:12** And I will go and bless the LORD your God and petition him concerning you, and may you walk in the right way and be blessed with blessings of heaven and of earth, of light and of the deep.

**25:13** And may your seed inherit the earth and fill the earth from east to west and from the north to the south, and may all the angels of the presence bless you and come before you.

**25:14** And stand firm, my son, and fear no man, and be not disheartened, and reign over all the seed of Seth.

**25:15** For you and your seed alone are elected to rule over all the earth, and among all the nations and peoples, in the name of the LORD you shall be great. And they shall call you the servants of the Most High, and you shall be the sons and heirs of the living God of heaven.

**25:16** And every spirit of truth is with you, and every angel of light is with you, and to rejoice in the LORD. So you shall rule over his sanctuary, and there shall be no uncleanness in your sanctuary.

**25:17** And now, my son, may the LORD God be with you, and may I see and bear glad tidings of your children, and I shall go to my fathers.

**25:18** And Jacob said to his mother Rebecca: "I am indeed blessed and glorious, and I shall walk in all the commandments of the LORD, and there shall be righteousness in my ways; and I will not forsake you, O my mother, but will seek the LORD all my days.

**25:19** And I bless you; and blessed are you and all the works of your hands, O my mother. For you have remembered me and I thank you greatly for your blessing."

**25:20** And thus, Rebecca called her son Esau and said to him: "My son, I beg you, do not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan."

**25:21** And Esau answered his mother and said: "I will not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan either; I will take a wife from among the daughters of my grandfather Ishmael." And Rebecca was comforted.

**25:22** And Isaac called Jacob and blessed him and commanded him, saying: "You shall not take a wife from all the daughters of Canaan. Arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and take a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother."

**25:23** "And may God Almighty bless you and multiply you and make you many in number, and may he make you into a multitude of nations, and may he give to you the blessing of my father Abraham — to you and to your seed after you — that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which God gave to Abraham."

---
*EMET notes: Rebecca's blessing (vv.11-16) is unique to Jubilees — more elaborate than anything in Genesis. "All the angels of the presence" (v.13) echoes Jubilees' angelology. "Sons of Seth" (v.14) = all humanity (cf. Num 24:17). The chapter formally launches Jacob's departure for Laban.*
